text:
Eli: quick thought for save-flow UX — show a small recommendation strip under model selector: Suggested / Cost-Safe / Fidelity. concise card, one-line rationale, est cost delta.

Rina: +1. users often forget routing fallbacks. strip should also show the likely fallback chain (primary -> fallback1) and a tiny latency hint.

Jasper: backend constraints: computing this live is expensive. plan: nightly rollup that writes suggestions to route index + a rate-limited on-demand recalc endpoint. keep payload tiny.

Maddie: UI idea: three compact cards horizontally with primary CTA to accept suggestion. show an info icon linking to a short popover: assumptions (tokens/call, window). keyboard accessible.

Eli: API sketch: GET /v1/savedviews/suggest?route_id=RID&team=TEAM -> returns suggestions array, each entry: model, est_cost_per_1000, est_p95_ms, rationale, assumptions_ref. client expects refresh_after secs.

Jasper: include a `guardrail_score` that flags suggestions exceeding org commit thresholds. don't suggest >3x cost unless team has large commit.

Rina: security: ensure suggestions are based on org-aggregated telemetry only. no cross-tenant leaks. audit log on suggestion generation.

Maddie: metrics we need: suggestion_shown, suggestion_chosen, suggestion_declined, suggestion_override_reason. tag with route_id and team_id.

Eli: rollout plan: behind FF, pilot with 2-3 customers, monitor acceptance and cost regressions. default toggle per-team: off.

Jasper: infra ticket created: JOB-1022 nightly-suggest-rollup. on-demand endpoint: POST /v1/savedviews/suggest/recalc?route=RID (rate-limited + auth).

Rina: docs: short explainer in Console help and a deeper doc on cost assumptions and routing policies. link from the info popover.

RolloutBot: Feature flag created: ff.savedviews.suggestions (owners: @Eli). Preview deploy: https://stg-console.redwood/savedviews-suggest

Maddie: I'll add design tokens and accessible styles. will mock API in storybook. PR to UI repo when mock exists.

Eli: owners: Jasper (backend + infra), Maddie (frontend), Rina (policy + docs). check-in Friday for staging validation. thanks!
